title: Part 3 军火库：That said 与 I'd go as far as to say
takeaway: I'd go as far as to say that AI will reshape education. That said, teachers will always matter.

lines: Bruce，Part 3 观点题军火库，开库。先说一个我自己发现的隐患：你所有的转折只有一把武器，but。But 来 but 去，考官听得毫无波澜。今天给你两把新武器。第一把：
话虽如此。它专门放在回答的后半段：先让一步，再扳回来。你上次聊孩子用手机，开头说得很好，smartphone is a double-edged sword，这个保留。但后半段别再 but 了，听母语者怎么接：
Smartphones are a double-edged sword. That said, if a kid has been taught self-discipline, there's no reason to panic.
先承认有刀刃，再给出不慌的理由。这就是 Part 3 要的思辨感。第二把武器，升级观点强度。当你想说"我甚至认为"，别只说 I think：
I'd go as far as to say that...

我甚至敢说。你上次聊 AI 改变教育，说的是 absolutely, 100%。用上新武器就是：I'd go as far as to say that AI will reshape education entirely. 顺便修一个旧伤。你说过：it depends how the children self-disciplining ability developed。意思全对，零件装反了。拆开重装：
It really depends on how well a kid can discipline themselves.
Depends on，加 how，加从句。这个骨架能接住一半的 Part 3。来，实战。真题打样，注意数武器：
Do you think technology will change education in the future?

Absolutely, and I'd go as far as to say that AI will reshape education completely within a decade. Lessons can already be tailored to each student's pace, which traditional classrooms simply can't do. That said, I don't think teachers will disappear, because education isn't just about transferring knowledge—it's also about motivation and human connection. So my prediction is a hybrid model: AI handles the drilling, and teachers focus on thinking and character. Whether that happens smoothly really depends on how quickly schools can adapt.

看到骨架了吗？I'd go as far as to say 开局亮剑，That said 中场让步，really depends on how 收尾留思。三件武器，一次打光，这就是考官想听的 Part 3。好，八秒实战。用 That said 或者 I'd go as far as to say，回答：Is it necessary for children to learn a foreign language? 必须出声。预备——
I'd go as far as to say that AI will reshape education. That said, teachers will always matter.
明天上手术台。手术对象，是你每分钟说八遍的 you know。Bruce，明天见。
